chapter: Ann Cook session and Buddy Petit stories
title: Rip Them Up Joe and Buddy Petit making up tunes
summary: Brief talk of who named 'Rip Them Up Joe' and Buddy Petit composing tunes as he went.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: This is Rip them up Joe, huh? Where does Rip them up Joe come from, anyhow? Who thought that up?

Buddy did, huh? He must have had quite a few novelist buddies. He must have had quite a few novelists. He must have had quite a few novelists. He must have had quite a few novelists. And Dad used to tell me about a tune he had called, Mr. Buddy, Mr. Buddy, Mr. Buddy Petite.
Yeah, man. Buddy, wake up, man. He's sleeping. I don't know. About stuff He's gone, huh? Yeah, he'd make up the tune as he could go. He's one who got a buddy to do.
Not anymore. He's one you can say he doesn't drink anymore. Yeah, he ain't been a moment.
